name: webscout-ai
description: Connect Claude to your WebScout AI workspace: pick up prospecting tasks and send researched businesses back to your CRM.
long_description: WebScout AI's local companion for Claude Desktop. Claude gets your queued WebScout tasks, researches public business information (with web search or computer use), and returns sourced results: new leads, verified business emails, facts and email drafts for your approval. The extension only relays WebScout's own tools to your workspace — it has no shell or file access. Your connection link is stored in your operating system's secure storage.

connection_link.title: WebScout connection link
connection_link.description: From WebScout → Claude → Connect Claude. It starts with https:// and contains /api/mcp/wsc_
